title: Workflow coverage
description: What the executions of one Temporal workflow type reached in the graph of that type: hit counts for every node, edge and handler, taken from event histories, and the events that found no place in the graph or no certain one.

workflowType.description: Workflow type name as registered with Temporal.

commit.description: Commit of the analysed repository the graph was produced from.

executions.description: Number of event histories laid over the graph.

events.description: Events laid on the graph, over all executions.

entryPoints.description: Every entry point of the graph, in the order of the graph.

nodes.description: Every node of the graph, by id.

edges.description: Every edge of the graph, followed by the edges it implies between regions and their children.

neverHit.description: Ids of the nodes that no execution reached. Nodes a history cannot show, those of query handlers, are left out.

closes.description: How the executions ended, and at which nodes.

ambiguous.description: Matches the histories do not settle. Whatever is in doubt was counted, and its hits are marked uncertain.

unmapped.description: Events that are a step of the workflow and have no node in the graph.

recognised.description: Events that are no step of a workflow and have no node, because they say what was done to an execution from outside: a request to cancel it, a pause, a change of its options. They are known for what they are and are not among the unmapped events. Absent when there are none.

histories.description: The executions, by the name of their history.

ambiguous.description: Events that fit several nodes and were counted for each of them.

unmapped.description: Events that are a step of the workflow and have no node.

recognised.description: Events that are no step of the workflow and have no node: what was done to the execution from outside, as when it is asked to cancel. Zero when left out.

recorded.description: False if histories do not show calls of this entry point: queries leave no event. True when left out.

hits.description: How often it was called, over all executions.

executions.description: In how many executions it was called.

recorded.description: False if histories cannot show this node: it belongs to a query handler. True when left out.

hits.description: How often the node was reached, over all executions. A region counts once each time it is entered, however many rounds a loop takes.

uncertain.description: How many of the hits are not certain. Zero when left out.

executions.description: How many executions reached the node.

kind.description: Kind of the edge; flow when left out.

implied.description: True for an edge between a region and one of its children that the graph leaves unwritten: from the region to a child it begins with, or from a child it ends with to the region.

recorded.description: False if histories cannot show this edge. True when left out.

hits.description: How often the edge was taken, over all executions. A wakes edge is taken once for every call of its handler that arrives while the execution waits at its await. A cancels edge is taken once for every event that says the step at its end was asked to cancel where the scope was cancelled.

uncertain.description: How many of the hits are not certain. Zero when left out.

executions.description: How many executions took the edge.

nodes.description: Where these executions ended. Empty if the end has no node: the execution was terminated or timed out, is still running, or failed with a failure that no throw in the workflow raised.

status.description: How an execution ended; running if its history ends before it does.

name.description: What the step is called in the history: an activity type, a signal name, the length of a timer.

doubt.description: candidates: several nodes fit the event, and each was counted. paths: the event has one node, but several ways lead there from the node before, and what lies on only some of them was counted too. outOfOrder: the event was laid on the only node of its name although the execution had no way to it.

likelySources.description: Ids of unknown nodes the execution had reached when the event was written. Any of them may hide the step.

eventType.description: The type of the event as the Temporal UI spells it, for example WorkflowExecutionCancelRequested.

file.description: Name of the history, as it was read.

closedAt.description: The nodes the execution ended at; empty if its end has no node.
